quote: 11.9 Governing Law. This Agreement, the rights and obligations of the parties hereto, and any claims or disputes relating thereto, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the state in which the Executive’s primary resident office is situated (but not including the choice of law rules thereof).
reason: The governing-law clause names no jurisdiction, pointing only to the state of the Executive's 'primary resident office'; Arizona appears only as the 'place of employment and work location' in Section 4, a different term, so under the rubric the answer is NONE.
